en.html: After looking into a few more stalls, we sat on a bench. Swimming through that crowd had been work for the legs also.

幾つかの店を覗いた後、ベンチに腰を下ろす。
　人込みの中を泳いで回ったせいで、それなりに足は
疲れていた。

en.html:
Muramasa"Whew."
Kageaki"I made you accompany me through all that."
Muramasa"I enjoyed it too, na. Though every shop was more or less the same shop wearing another face."
Kageaki"Yes. That sort of shop... an antique shop, I mean."
Kageaki"When I was a child, I used to dream of running one once I grew up."
Muramasa"Really?"
Kageaki"It was a long time ago... But the dream a child puts in his heart does not always agree to vacate."

景明「付き合わせたな」
村正「私も楽しかったし。 　けど回ったのって、似たような店ばかりね」
景明「ああ。 　あのような店……つまり骨董屋だが」
景明「大人になったらあれをやろうと、子供の頃、 夢見ていた」
村正「そうなの」
景明「昔の話だが……。 　幼心に描いた夢は、まだ胸に残っている」

空の果てを見詰め。
　儚い何かを掴むように、俺は拳を握った。

en.html:
Kageaki"All day inside a dim shop, breathing that lovely mold smell and polishing a Wanli jar... Yes. For me, that was the life. Full happiness, poor lighting."
Muramasa"...O-oh. Achha..."
Kageaki"It never came true, though."
Muramasa"Arre, how have you decided that already?"
Kageaki"...?"
Muramasa"You can start now also, no?"
Kageaki"..."
Kageaki"I see. ...Yes. I suppose I can..."
Muramasa"Exactly."
Kageaki"...And you?"
Muramasa"Hm?"
Kageaki"Was there nothing you dreamed of becoming, when you were small?"
Muramasa"...Well. In my case, being born where I was..."
Muramasa"When you are born into an Emishi smith's family, becoming a tsurugi is the future. Some other future, you don't even think of it."
Kageaki"I see..."

村正「……ふ、ふぅん……」
景明「叶わなかったがな」
村正「それはわからないでしょ？」
景明「……？」
村正「今からやっても、いいじゃない」
景明「…………」
景明「そうか。 　……そうだな……」
村正「うん」
景明「……お前は？」
村正「え？」
景明「何か、無かったのか。 　子供の頃の夢は」
村正「…………。 　私は、生まれが生まれだったから」
村正「蝦夷の鍛冶師の家に生まれついた者は劒冑 に成る以外の将来なんて考えないものよ」
景明「そうか……」

en.html: In the end, a person can take only one path. That much is true. But even so... to have no choice offered from the beginning itself seemed a lonely thing.

どのみち、人が選べる道は一つきりだ。
　しかしそれでも……最初から選択肢を与えられない
というのは、寂しい事のように思える。

en.html:
Muramasa"Well... saying there was absolutely nothing would not be quite true."
Kageaki"There was something?"
Muramasa"Only a small 'wouldn't that be nice' sort of thing. When I was little..."
Muramasa"I heard the ladies at court wore beautiful clothes every day. And once, before I could stop my mouth, out came 'I want to be one too.'"
Muramasa"...Mother heard. And the scolding I got, arre..."
Kageaki"A lady at the imperial court."

村正「宮中の女官は毎日綺麗な衣装を着てるって 聞いて。 　私もなりたいって、つい言っちゃったこと がある」
村正「……母様に聞かれて、こっぴどく怒られた けどね……」
景明「宮中の女官か」

村正が憧れたものは、やはりああいった、<ruby>煌<rt>きら</rt></ruby>びやかな

Kageaki"...Hm."
Muramasa"What?"
Kageaki"Nothing. ...I was thinking, if it could be arranged..."
Kageaki"But making that dream of yours come true seems a little beyond my arrangements."

en.html: For a moment Muramasa blinked at me. Then she burst out laughing.

en.html:
Muramasa"Arre, leave it, silly man. I was small, I knew nothing. Some pretty clothes caught my imagination, bas."
Muramasa"Even if I had had the connections to become a court lady, a tsurugi is what I would have chosen."
Kageaki"..."
Muramasa"Because I became a tsurugi, I could meet you."
Muramasa"Maybe that was only chance bringing us together... But that time two months ago, you..."
Muramasa"You told me you needed me—remember?"

景明「……」
村正「劒冑になったから、貴方に会えた」
村正「それは偶然の巡り合わせだったのかもしれ ないけれど……。 　二月前のあの時、貴方は」
村正「私のことを―― 　必要だって、言ってくれたでしょう？」

Kageaki"..."
Muramasa"So, for me, that is enough."
Muramasa"So much happened before we reached here... I cannot look at all that past and say, yes, all of it was right. The mistakes alone, where would I finish counting? But becoming a tsurugi..."
Muramasa"Now... that one thing, I can be glad I did."
Kageaki"...Muramasa..."

en.html:
My heart seemed to have suddenly increased its workload. Here and there, my body was getting strangely hot also.

What sort of feeling was this?

Whatever it was, first I had to become calm. I looked away from Muramasa.

動悸が急に激しくなったような気がした。
　体の其処彼処に妙な熱さを感じる。

　この心地は何なのか。
　とにかく落ち着こうと、俺は村正から目を逸らした。

en.html:
Muramasa"What happened?"
Kageaki"Nothing."
Muramasa"You're being a little strange."
Kageaki"There is no such development."
Muramasa"What are you thinking?"
Kageaki"Nothing in particular."
Muramasa"Achha?"
Kageaki"...What?"
Muramasa"I was thinking, perhaps a little mental interference, and I can read it myself."
Kageaki"Don't."
Muramasa"I'm joking. You'll tell me without all that, won't you?"
Kageaki"...Uhh..."
Kageaki"..."
Muramasa"Now you're looking for a way to dodge."
Kageaki"Ah... yes. That earlier subject."
Muramasa"Which earlier subject?"
Kageaki"The ladies at court."
Muramasa"Arre, I told you, leave that."
Kageaki"Getting you into the imperial court is not within my powers. But... something close to it, a small experience of what it might be like, that much may be possible."
Muramasa"? What do you mean?"
Kageaki"I have a small idea."
